chunks: "Indeed, he emerges from his sins as though it were the day his mother gave birth to him."

key_terms.كَهَيْئَةِ: in the manner or state of

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe being freed from sins after the rite?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a state of complete purification from sins. It conveys that the person returns spiritually pure, like a newborn on the day of birth.
